DESCRIPTION.locations: Required. Path configuration for PST processing, conversion, extraction and email search help.
DESCRIPTION.locations.pst_dir: Required. Directory containing the source PST files.
DESCRIPTION.locations.mbox_dir: Required. Directory where converted MBOX files are written.
DESCRIPTION.locations.eml_dir: Required. Directory where converted EML files are written.
DESCRIPTION.locations.contacts_dir: Required. Directory where extracted contacts are saved as VCard (.vcf) files.
DESCRIPTION.locations.calendars_dir: Required. Directory where extracted calendar appointments are saved as iCalendar (.ics) files.
DESCRIPTION.locations.attachments_dir: Required. Directory where extracted email attachments are saved.
DESCRIPTION.locations.work_dir: Required. Temporary working directory used when viewing and processing PST emails.
DESCRIPTION.locations.search_readme_path: Required. Path to the Markdown guide displayed by View Email Search Help.
DESCRIPTION.search_configs: Required. List of paths to JSON email search configurations. Each defines search_location, results_location, match and criteria. Search emails runs the selected configurations and saves matching emails; View Search Results loads saved EML files from their results_location directories without rerunning searches. All Search Configurations combines results into one paginated table; when viewing saved results, Matched identifies the configuration by its filename stem.
